method: Direct visual inspection of original Playwright PNGs using view_image; no image edits. Screenshot hashes are listed in archive-sha256.json.

observations.fit/first-ready-back.png: Entire buttocks covered with continuous opaque fabric. Complete head, arms and lower legs visible; no exposed gray hip patches. Same crop and camera as original failure.
observations.fit/first-ready-pressure.png: Pressure mode selected, localized hip load and SI legend visible; PASS metrics and zero exposed samples.
observations.browser/strain.png: Actual strain view shows waist concentration and lower values through the skirt; scalar definitions and units visible.
observations.browser/stress.png: Stress mode selected with a separate kPa legend, actual waist concentration and complete covered skirt.
observations.browser/contact.png: Distance mode uses millimetres and actual near-hip regions, distinct from normal pressure.
observations.fit/mobile.png: 390 px page shows covered side view, replay controls, physical parameters and metrics without horizontal clipping.

scope: Visual inspection supports, and does not replace, independent geometry and force/tensor checks.
